name: Expert Familiar
summary: Elixir that upgrades a Basic Familiar to Expert (2 Trick Slots).

name: Racial Empowerment Mutagen
summary: Racial Innate Passive doubled if numeric, or Hastened if a Counted Action; only one at a time.

name: Toughness Mutagen
summary: +25 Temporary Life Points or +25 Temporary Armor Points (set when crafted) at the start of each re-pop.

name: Eagle Eye Mutagen
summary: Gain 1 Basic Component each time you disarm a trap or pick a lock (destroying it).

name: Fortitude Mutagen
summary: +10 Life Points or +10 Armor Points (set when crafted).

name: Greater Primordial Mutagen
summary: Weapon/claw/bite attacks always use one of the six elements (set when crafted); Planar Asylum to that Elemental Plane.

name: Master Familiar
summary: Elixir that upgrades an Expert Familiar to Master (3 Trick Slots).

name: Serpent's Touch Mutagen
summary: Aqua Mortis pastes can be applied to your natural weapons.

name: Enrichment Mutagen
summary: Gain an Amplified Life Enhancement Slot at the start of each re-pop.

name: Grandmaster Familiar
summary: Elixir that upgrades a Master Familiar to Grandmaster (4 Trick Slots).

name: Intensity Mutagen
summary: Racial Innate Active ability works at its Expert Technique, still once per encounter.

name: Ley Link Mutagen
summary: Once per re-pop, all your attacks become Magic for the encounter.

name: Reinforcing Mutagen
summary: One use of each of your racial skills once per re-pop.
